QuestInfo.name: Do Gong's in Trouble
QuestInfo.1: The King Sage Cat says that he's willing to make amends with #bDo Gong#k, and offers a red marble, a miracle medicine, to Do Gong as a sign of goodwill. Talk to Do Gong and pass along the King Sage Cat's offer.
QuestInfo.2: That 'miracle medicine' was actually poison! Will Do Gong be able to survive this? Check his pulse!

0.0: Oh, I have no intentions of getting angry at Do Gong. I am the benevolent King Sage Cat, after all. I know he framed me, but I'd rather not make matters worse. In fact, I'd prefer to clear up any misunderstandings between us. You'll help us through this process, won't you?\r\n\r\n#b(You will be moved to Mu Lung Temple if you accept.)#k

yes.0: Hehehehe. I knew you would say that. Now, please take this #rRed Marble#k to #bDo Gong#k. It's a great Miracle Medicine that should help everyone focus while training. This should also help Do Gong with his spells. Hopefully this will open the doors for us to be on friendly terms again. He he he!

no.0: You don't wish to help us be back on friendly terms? Traveler, you... have some issues, I think.

1.0: You're back. Now, if you did what you needed to do, then it'll greatly decrease the King Sage Cat's powers... Hmm, what's that you're holding there?

yes.0: Uck! That.. That's poison?! A poison made out of magic?

npc.0: You haven't gone to #bDo Gong#k yet? I want to be on friendly terms with Do Gong ASAP! Ho ho ho!

item.0: Hmmm, the King Sage Cat's powers don't seem to have grown any weaker, but...

lost.0: Whaaaaat? You lost the red marble? That precious marble...! How... how did you??? Hmph, I can't lose dignity over this. Okay, I will forgive you for now. I will give you the red marble one more time, so... PLEASE! PLEASE give that to Do Gong.
